originality.rationale: The examined 2018 source assumes i.i.d. positive random steps and proves geometric conservation, not sharp terminal phase-dispersion differences between independence and uniform-marginal countermonotonic time-step pairs. The 2022 comparison studies additive centered independent randomization. Classic rearrangement is explicitly prior work; the distinctive non-implied claim is the exact \(h^{2\alpha-1}\) versus \(h^{4\alpha+1}\) dispersion law with coefficients \(T\kappa^2/3\) and \(T\kappa^4/90\) for an actual midpoint output, and the fixed-T pairing construct.
